# Cineálacha agus aicmí imeachtaí

The viewer adds an **Event type** column to every dataset that has an event column (`event`, `events`, `event_type` or `event_name`). Each game's own words are mapped to one of these kinds (upper and lower case alike); a word not listed counts as *Other*.

| Kind | Shown as | Words in the data |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | Suíomh | `(empty)`, `position`, `pos`, `sample`, `move`, `vehicle` |
| `fire` | Urchar | `burst`, `shot`, `gun_shot`, `fire`, `fire_start`, `fire_stop`, `weapon_fire`, `slash`, `hasfired`, `shoot`, `fired`, `tracer` |
| `launch` | Seoladh (diúracán, roicéad, buama) | `launch`, `launched`, `torpedo`, `throw`, `release` |
| `hit` | Buille | `hit`, `hit_critical`, `hit_severe`, `struck`, `impact`, `hasbeenhitby` |
| `miss` | Iomrall | `miss`, `missed` |
| `explosion` | Pléasc | `explosion`, `flak`, `he`, `molotov`, `inferno`, `smoke`, `flash`, `explode` |
| `damage` | Damáiste | `hurt`, `damage`, `damaged`, `module_destroyed`, `wounded`, `fire_on`, `blind` |
| `kill` | Maraigh | `kill`, `kills` |
| `death` | Bás | `death`, `dead`, `died`, `killed` |
| `destroyed` | Scriosta | `destroyed` |
| `crash` | Tuairt | `crash`, `crashed` |
| `eject` | Díbirt | `eject`, `ejected`, `bailout`, `bailedout` |
| `spawn` | Beirtear | `spawn`, `respawn`, `revived`, `created` |
| `despawn` | Imíonn | `despawn`, `removed`, `leftarea`, `timeout` |
| `takeoff` | Éirí den talamh | `takenoff`, `takeoff` |
| `landing` | Tuirlingt | `landed`, `landing` |
| `touchdown` | Teagmháil leis an talamh | `touchdown`, `touch_and_go` |
| `stop` | Stad | `stop`, `parked` |
| `rearm` | Atharmáil / athbhreoslú | `rearm`, `rearmed`, `refuel`, `refuelled`, `refueled`, `repair`, `repaired` |
| `capture` | Gabháil / cuspóir | `captured`, `capture`, `neutralised`, `neutralized`, `plant`, `defuse` |
| `decoy` | Mealladh | `flare`, `chaff`, `decoy`, `countermeasure` |
| `message` | Teachtaireacht | `chat`, `message`, `command`, `bookmark`, `debug`, `comment` |
| `other` | Eile | `grenade`, `projectile`, `nade`, `thrown`, `flight` |

## Vehicle classes

The **Vehicle class** and **Target class** columns use these classes, worked out from vehicle names (through the [figure catalogue](figures.md)) and type columns.

| Class | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `fighter` | Trodaire |
| `attack` | Aerárthach ionsaithe |
| `bomber` | Buamadóir |
| `otherAir` | Aerárthach eile |
| `helicopter` | Héileacaptar |
| `tank` | Umar |
| `armoured` | Feithicil armúrtha |
| `spaa` | Aerchosaint |
| `artillery` | Airtléire |
| `truck` | Trucail / carr |
| `ship` | Long |
| `submarine` | Fomhuireán |
| `infantry` | Coisithe |
| `weapon` | Arm |
| `decoy` | Mealladh |
| `structure` | Struchtúr |
| `other` | Eile |
